facts.text: Rodia was a remote and swampy jungle planet.

facts.text: Rodia was a hot, humid world which was covered in dense tropical jungles which had been gradually giving place to sprawling cities, swamps and industrial areas.

evidence.quote: Rodia was a hot, humid world which was covered in dense tropical jungles which had been gradually giving place to sprawling cities, swamps and industrial areas.

facts.text: Small axial tilt meant the climate was stable among the seasons.

evidence.quote: Small axial tilt meant the climate was stable among the seasons.

facts.text: Landmasses were concentrated on two big continents—Betu in the western hemisphere, and Encheeko in the eastern—and several big islands between them.

evidence.quote: Landmasses were concentrated on two big continents—Betu in the western hemisphere, and Encheeko in the eastern—and several big islands between them.

facts.text: The empty Rodiak Ocean separated the two continents; the An'yettu Islands spanned between the Ioliu and the Wesessa Seas among the continents.

evidence.quote: The empty Rodiak Ocean separated the two continents; the An'yettu Islands spanned between the Ioliu and the Wesessa Seas among the continents.

facts.text: The Rodians built their cities on waterways and protected them with environmental shields, bubble domes that surrounded all habitation structures and allowed entry and exit for vehicles and vessels.

evidence.quote: The Rodians built their cities on waterways and protected them with environmental shields, bubble domes that surrounded all habitation structures and allowed entry and exit for vehicles and vessels.

facts.text: Two major cities on the planet were Equator City and Iskaayuma which were the planetary capitals at different periods in Rodia's history.

evidence.quote: Two major cities on the planet were Equator City and Iskaayuma which were the planetary capitals at different periods in Rodia's history.

facts.text: Equator City was the traditional capital until Navik usurped control over the planet and moved the capital to his clan's settlement at Iskaayuma.

evidence.quote: Equator City was the traditional capital until Navik usurped control over the planet and moved the capital to his clan's settlement at Iskaayuma.

facts.text: Rodia's jungles used to host a variety of fauna and flora which were wiped out or made endangered over the millennia as the Rodians improved their technology and increased their population.

evidence.quote: Rodia's jungles used to host a variety of fauna and flora which were wiped out or made endangered over the millennia as the Rodians improved their technology and increased their population.

facts.text: Later cities sprawled over the reducing jungle areas.

evidence.quote: Later cities sprawled over the reducing jungle areas.

facts.text: The Rodian Karstag, newoongall and the ghest were native Rodian predators; however they were driven to near-extinction when the Rodians became the dominant species of the planet.

evidence.quote: The Rodian Karstag, newoongall and the ghest were native Rodian predators; however they were driven to near-extinction when the Rodians became the dominant species of the planet.

facts.text: Over time, these evolved into the sentient Rodian species, who became brutal hunters to survive among the planet's dangerous wildlife.

evidence.quote: Over time, these evolved into the sentient Rodian species, who became brutal hunters to survive among the planet's dangerous wildlife.

facts.text: Eventually, all of the predators that threatened the Rodians were driven to extinction, and the Rodians began to hunt one another, finding or inventing excuses for war and laying waste to their homeworld's environment in the process.

evidence.quote: Eventually, all of the predators that threatened the Rodians were driven to extinction, and the Rodians began to hunt one another, finding or inventing excuses for war and laying waste to their homeworld's environment in the process.

facts.text: Grand Protectors ruled all of Rodia as dictators.

evidence.quote: Grand Protectors ruled all of Rodia as dictators.

facts.text: When scouts from the Galactic Republic arrived on Rodia, the planet's ecosystem was on the verge of being damaged beyond repair.

evidence.quote: When scouts from the Galactic Republic arrived on Rodia, the planet's ecosystem was on the verge of being damaged beyond repair.

facts.text: The Grand Protector's Hunters' Guild, or Goa-Ato, instituted annual awards (or Atiang) for the best hunters, with such categories as "Best Shot", "Longest Trail", or "Most Notorious Capture."

evidence.quote: The Grand Protector's Hunters' Guild, or Goa-Ato, instituted annual awards (or Atiang) for the best hunters, with such categories as "Best Shot", "Longest Trail", or "Most Notorious Capture."

facts.text: The Rodians eventually joined the Republic, fascinated by its starships and weapons.

evidence.quote: The Rodians eventually joined the Republic, fascinated by its starships and weapons.

facts.text: Demand for weapons led to increased industrialization, especially around the megalopolis of Equator City.

evidence.quote: Demand for weapons led to increased industrialization, especially around the megalopolis of Equator City.

facts.text: During the Great Sith War, an alliance of Sith and Mandalorians won a battle at Rodia.

evidence.quote: During the Great Sith War, an alliance of Sith and Mandalorians won a battle at Rodia.

facts.text: Sith forces attempted to destroy the planet using the massive firepower of the Star Forge fleet, hoping to deny the Galactic Republic its greatest source of scouts and explorers.

evidence.quote: Sith forces attempted to destroy the planet using the massive firepower of the Star Forge fleet, hoping to deny the Galactic Republic its greatest source of scouts and explorers.

facts.text: But the Jedi uncovered the plot and signaled the Republic fleet for help.

evidence.quote: But the Jedi uncovered the plot and signaled the Republic fleet for help.

facts.text: The Battle of Rodia was an important battle of the Jedi Civil War, and after the Republic drove away the Sith fleet, Rodia officially joined the war on the Republic side, though individual Rodian mercenaries still worked for the Sith and other factions.

evidence.quote: The Battle of Rodia was an important battle of the Jedi Civil War, and after the Republic drove away the Sith fleet, Rodia officially joined the war on the Republic side, though individual Rodian mercenaries still worked for the Sith and other factions.

evidence.quote: Following the Great Galactic War, Rodia was annexed by the Sith Empire under the partial Treaty of Coruscant.
